scale: Each pillar is scored 0-10 on an anchored rubric (see career/02-roles/role-rankings.md section 1). lo/mid/hi = plausible range given evidence quality; Monte Carlo samples a triangular distribution (lo, mid, hi).
grades: EGP-1.0 grades of the evidence behind each pillar: A primary record; B authoritative secondary or platform aggregate with disclosed method (JobsPipe, Fast AI Jobs and Levels.fyi pages are B); C practitioner, small-corpus or vendor survey; D judgement or recalled; M model output from graded inputs (treated as C for confidence).

application.name: Application
application.tests: Coding, RAG or agent system design, and evaluation (plus an emerging AI-assisted build variant at AI-native firms such as Sierra, OpenAI and Anthropic)

customer-application.name: Application plus customer scoping
customer-application.tests: Coding and debugging (often practical or production-adjacent), system architecture or decomposition (RAG, agents, enterprise integration, evals), and customer scoping, discovery or technical-presentation rounds

ml-system-design.name: Classic ML system design
ml-system-design.tests: ML depth and breadth, coding (including ML-from-scratch or AI-assisted coding at AI-native firms), behavioural and leadership rounds, plus at most one classic ML system design round (recommendation, ranking, fraud or ETA; absent in some Microsoft loops)

infrastructure.name: Infrastructure
infrastructure.tests: sub-discipline specific: serving and inference (systems coding, distributed-systems design; KV-cache maths, decode roofline, continuous batching and prefill/decode disaggregation appear in prep guides [C]), GPU cluster ops (Slurm, InfiniBand/RDMA, NCCL debugging, bare-metal failure recovery, Kubernetes at scale), MLOps/ML platform (IaC, CI/CD, drift monitoring, feature stores, ML job schedulers) and GPU kernels (simulated-accelerator take-home [A, COI], profiler walkthrough, roofline analysis, numerics/dtype tolerances)

evaluation.name: Evaluation design
evaluation.tests: golden sets, judge calibration, online sampling, A/B tests, plus 2–4 hour eval-harness take-homes and eval-system or eval-data design rounds (practitioner guides, C)

research.name: Research
research.tests: coding-led loops and paid work trials for Research Engineer and AI Safety roles (Anthropic Python-only coding with AI-partnership rules [A, COI], xAI 1-week loop [A], FAR.AI 72-min coding plus work trial [B]; research talk not confirmed for RE or safety), versus quiz, coding and research/past-work talk for Research Scientist (DeepMind [A], xAI [A])

governance.name: Governance
governance.tests: scoping or solutions rounds, EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001 fluency, and 45–90 minute risk-assessment work samples (vendor prep guides C/D; employer-confirmed loops absent E); Responsible AI Engineer adds hybrid coding and guardrail-engineering rounds

product.name: Product
product.tests: AI product sense, offline and online evaluation design, failure-mode and rubric framing, and technical depth (plus timed AI-assisted build rounds at AI-native firms)

product-frontend.name: AI product & frontend engineering
product-frontend.tests: Live streaming-UI and React/TypeScript build (token streaming, cancel/retry, state, accessibility), frontend system design including backing API, real-codebase take-home and product/design craft

robot-learning.name: Robot learning
robot-learning.tests: real-hardware failure questions, demonstration curation, sim-to-real gaps, evaluation of rare but dangerous failures, practical coding rather than puzzles, and a presentation of past work or a design round on the employer's own robots (prep guides, C; Apptronik's knock-out application questions are employer-published, A)

leverage.basis: Judgement. Client project delivery and direct advisory; agency channel rates ($50–$80/hr US) compress leverage vs direct senior engagements [T0-66].

access.basis: 5+ years, >=50 referral sources, 6 months of reserves [T2-01:631-635]; Toptal <3% screen + 2-wk paid test project (C), IT Jobs Watch senior build bar (B) and 53–75% network sourcing in independent surveys (C, U47) [T0-66].
